events.title: Gomoklear is at Steam Next Fest
events.summary: Hey players — Gomoklear is part of Steam Next Fest! Come try the Demo.The Demo already includes a full Run: Matches, Serendipity, the Stall, Famous Matches, through to the Final Match.Play four sharply different ways to do Gomoku — Playstyles Overgrowth, Breakthrough, Encore, and High Cloud:Overgrowth: flood the board with spawned pieces and win by numbersBreakthrough: remove enemy pieces and stop their fivesEncore: extra turns — place more piecesHigh Cloud: move pieces and connect freelyMake fi

events.title: Demo v0.6 Update
events.summary: Hey players — the Gomoklear Demo is now on v0.6!This update brings a fresh way to play: the High Cloud Playstyle. Pieces you move gain Gomoku Line Count equal to how far they traveled that Round.Run difficulty also opens up to level 5.What's new:New Playstyle High Cloud: unlocks after playing Encore. Move pieces to boost Gomoku Line Count.Blue move pieces: Cycle, Crowbar, Trebuchet, Elevator, Meteor, Aquarius, Earth, and more are now in the pool.New Manuscripts: Gust, Breaker, Twister.Difficulty

events.title: Demo v0.4 Update
events.summary: Hey players — the Gomoklear Demo is now on v0.4!This update is a big step. What used to stop halfway through a two-Act Run is now a full three-Act campaign. At last, the Demo lets you feel a complete run and its pacing! :)We've also added a brand-new Playstyle: Encore. It lets you gain extra Turns to play pieces, and remakes Gomoku even more thoroughly. events.title: Demo v0.3 Update
events.summary: Hey players — the Gomoklear Demo is now on v0.3!What's new:UI refresh: match and menu visuals fully redrawn. Under a unified Eastern wood interface, the board feels brand new.Tutorial: a detailed Tutorial you can open anytime during a run.Content: newly unlocked pieces, plus the Serendipity Stargazing; Famous Matches now include the Greed Rival, who gains extra Turns as the Turn sequence goes on.The Demo will keep updating. If you like it, please wishlist or download and play it! Bugs or ideas?

events.title: Demo v0.2 Update
events.summary: Hey players — the Gomoklear Demo just got an update!What's new:Controller support: play matches and navigate menus fully with a gamepad.Controls help: there's a controls button on the right side of the match screen — open it for keyboard and gamepad prompts.Game content: tweaked Playstyle unlock order and starting Libraries.Run into a bug, have feedback, or want to help test? Hop into our Discord anytime!

events.title: Demo Now Available
events.summary: The Gomoklear Demo is now available!Play DemoConnect five. Clear the line. Break the board—familiar Gomoku (five in a row), rebuilt as a roguelike where every move can reshape the board.Within the Round Limit, rack up multiple five-in-a-rows—or go for six, seven, and beyond!What's in the Demo right now: A short two-Act run: Matches, Serendipity, the Stall, and Famous Matches with different rules.A new Gomoku rhythm: asymmetric Rounds. You act twice; your Rival acts once.Powered pieces and builds
